title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 1: One Earnings Account per Driver
content:
**1.1** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, a driver has exactly one earnings account, opened when the driver signs a driver services agreement and linked to that agreement. A driver whose earnings account is closed gets a new one only with a new agreement.

**1.2** An earnings account is opened only when the driver has no earnings account that is awaiting payout setup, active or on payout hold. The company's own account records decide this, read for the same driver.

**1.3** Every new account starts at Wayfare Pro Blue for the rest of the quarter in which it opens.

## Clause 1 restated as a table

| Driver's existing earnings accounts, as the records show them | Can a new earnings account be opened? |
|---|---|
| None | Yes, with the signing of a driver services agreement |
| One awaiting payout setup | No |
| One active | No |
| One on payout hold | No |
| Only closed accounts, and a new driver services agreement is signed | Yes |

The limit is 1 open earnings account per driver at any time: an account awaiting payout setup, an active account and an account on payout hold each count as open; a closed account does not.

## Hypothetical illustration

A driver whose earlier account was closed when an agreement ended signs a new driver services agreement in the middle of a quarter. A new earnings account is opened, linked to the new agreement, and it carries Wayfare Pro Blue until that quarter ends.
